name: pin-head-cmd
setup: window.MefiNav.go("command"); await window.MefiIdle.ready(); window.MefiIdle.setOrbit?.("paused", { quiet: true }); const o = window.MefiNodeStyles; window.MefiNodeStyles = Object.freeze({ ...o, tier(r) { return o.tier(r, 3); } });  return true;
